versions.changelog:
huawei-cloud-sac-dify 1.0.1

- Initial public release for deploying Dify (open-source LLM app development platform) on Huawei Cloud using ECS via Terraform/SAC.
- Provides detailed, step-by-step deployment instructions, including extraction of solution info, template download, variable confirmation, deployment, verification, and cleanup.
- Supports both Dify community versions and flexus-ai-agent mode with selectable parameters.
- Emphasizes security best practices (never expose or transmit AK/SK in chat).
- Outputs and scripts use standardized JSON formats for integration and verification.
- User interaction points require explicit confirmation before sensitive operations like apply and destroy.
